name: Wavelog Synchroniser
author: on8st
description: Extension of the Zeus Logbook feature: keeps your log in step with a Wavelog instance, both directions. Pushes every contact you log, imports contacts logged by other apps, sweeps LoTW and QSL confirmations back, and can publish live rig state. It is not a logbook and never owns your QSOs. REQUIRES the "Zeus Logbook" feature (org.openhpsdr.logbook) — without it there is no log to synchronise and this does nothing.
